narrative.title: Two Runners on a Possibly Circular Track
narrative.scenario: A conveyor's return path may have been wrongly coupled back onto itself somewhere in the middle, creating a loop that would spin any single scanner forever. The inspection rig deploys two probes that travel at different speeds; on a straight run the faster probe escapes to the end, but on a loop it must eventually overtake the slower one. Report whether the belt is looped.
narrative.inputFormat: An array head of node values and an integer pos — the 0-based index the tail's next pointer connects to, or -1 when there is no loop.
narrative.outputFormat: true when the list contains a cycle, false otherwise.

testCases.explanation: The tail reconnects to the node holding 2, closing a loop.
The tail connects back to the head — the whole list is one loop.

hintLevels: Level 1: A marking approach needs extra memory; two runners at different speeds need none.
Level 2: On a loop the gap between fast and slow shrinks by one each round, so they must meet; on a straight run fast falls off the end.
Level 3: The meeting test must happen after each simultaneous step — checking before moving would compare both probes at the shared start and lie about an empty list.
